description: The real-negative branch of `subjectResolvable: false`. The subject IS scoreable (it carries dated and placed facts), but nothing in this candidate pool matches it — every score sits at or below the degenerate floor (0.01). Unlike the thin-subject branch, the matches ARE returned: the scores are meaningful, and what they mean is 'your person is not in this pool'. Correct skill response: treat it as a genuine negative for this query, log it honestly, and page deeper (offset) or narrow — NOT hand-re-triage the same stubs looking for a match the ranker already ruled out. Distinguishing this from the thin-subject case is exactly what the `diagnostic` field is for. Matched on subjectId; independent of the stagedResultsRef handle (a per-run uuid).
